Your plan
- Now: Ask Northwind HR whether they need anything from you about the lost card.
- Now: Check replacement processing times and the current fee on uscis.gov before you file.
- At STEM OPT: Remember that a STEM OPT approval brings a new card anyway. Your filing window runs Nov 15, 2026 to Feb 13, 2027.

Watch out for
- You need the card itself to return to the US on OPT, so plan any trip abroad around having it.
- Your STEM window opens in 46 days. Weigh a replacement now against waiting for the STEM card.

Ask your DSO
Whether to replace the card now or wait for the STEM OPT card depends on your own situation, so ask your DSO.
